| OS | Windows currently tested; the installer uses only N"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ode APIs, other platforms untested |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"This is **not** a standalone web app. It is a DSH profile bundle: the Host half adds
one route, the "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"Client half adds one panel to the settings dialog."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The installer:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"1. finds your DSH profile (`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`, override with `--profile <dir>`);

3. adds `"dsh-usage-overview": "link:<repo path>"` to the profi"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"le dependencies;
4. adds `dsh-usage-overview` to `dsh.profile.bundles`;
5. runs `pnpm install` with "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"the pnpm bundled in your DSH runtime;
6. prints the restart step."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Then **restart DeepSeek Harness** and open

entry to `~/.dsh/"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"profiles/desktop/package.json`, then run `pnpm install` from that
directory and restart DSH:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Host** (`lib/index.js`) registers `/usage-overview/summary`. It uses the account
grant that DSH "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"already holds, calls the Platform `/api/v0/usage/by_api_key/*`
endpoints (31-day aligned windows, ca"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ched), and returns **numbers only**.
- **Client** (`lib/client.js`) renders the panel in a DSH overl"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ay slot and fetches that
route. It never talks to `platform.deepseek.com` directly."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**Security:** the account token never leaves the Host process and is never sent to the
client; the r"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"oute returns aggregated totals and daily/monthly buckets. The plugin has
no telemetry and no third-p"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"arty dependencies at runtime — React and the DSH UI
primitives are provided by DSH itself."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Caveats"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- DSH's plugin APIs (`shell.overlay` slot, profile web server routes, UI primitives)
are not a stabl"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"e public contract. A future DSH update can break this plugin; check
the issue tracker before upgradi"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ng DSH.
- The Platform API truncates a single usage query to 31 day-aligned days, so all-time
and mo"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"nthly totals are summed from consecutive windows. A monthly total can differ
from the platform's own"},{"id":"p26s5","text":" lifetime total by a few cents due to rounding.
- The month table starts at the month of the account"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"'s first API key; months before
that are disabled in the picker."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Uninstall"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Then restart DSH. If you installed manually, remove the dependency and the bundle

entry and run `pnpm install` again."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Troubleshooting"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"**`git clone` fails with `Failed to connect to github.com:443`**"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Some networks block GitHub's HTTPS edge. Clone over SSH instead (GitHub serves
